decisive_items: EEG findings:  Title: Right hemispheric rhythmic activities
quasi-periodic fashion at intervals of about one second, during which the patient presented significant dizziness, vertigo and dull response
rhythmic epileptiform discharges originating from the right frontal area
response.rationale: EEG shows clear right frontal rhythmic epileptiform discharges temporally linked to the episodes, strongly supporting epilepsy. R3 (seizure disorder) is similar but less specific; R1, R5, R2 lack EEG support and are contradicted by normal posterior circulation MRI and absence of brainstem signs.

rejected.why: No posterior circulation MRI changes; EEG points to epileptic origin, not vascular.
Less specific than epilepsy; same EEG evidence but label is broader.
No focal brainstem signs and MRI excludes posterior circulation involvement.
Hypertension alone does not explain episodic EEG discharges or focal motor symptoms.
